# 1 Enoch Chapter 68 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**1** After this, my grandfather Enoch gave me the full summary of all the secret teachings contained in the book of the Parables — the book that had been given to him — and he compiled them for me in the words of the book of the Parables.

**2** That day Michael turned to Raphael and said: "The power of the Spirit moves through me and fills me with trembling at the sheer severity of this judgment on the secrets — the judgment of the angels. Who can bear such a severe judgment when it falls, when they melt away before it?"

**3** Michael spoke again to Raphael: "Is there anyone whose heart remains unmoved by this, or whose inner being is not shaken by the verdict that has gone out against them — against those who led others out in this way?"

**4** Then, standing before the Lord of Spirits, Michael said to Raphael: "I will not stand up for them before the Lord's eyes. The Lord of Spirits is furious with them because they acted as though they were the Lord himself.

**5** Therefore everything that has been kept hidden will come down on them — forever and ever. For neither angel nor human being will receive any share in their case; they receive their judgment entirely alone, forever and ever."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Ch. 68's dialogue between Michael and Raphael is the most intimate exchange between archangels in all of 1 Enoch. Michael's refusal to intercede (v. 4) is remarkable — even the highest archangel will not plead for the fallen ones. The charge 'they acted as if they were the Lord' (v. 4b) is the ultimate theological indictment.*
